messages:
Maya (Support): heads-up — customer CS-4128 (AcmePay) reporting chart legend labels do not match series on mobile. They say tooltip for 'payments_success' shows values for 'refunds' and legend order flips when they rotate the phone. Also they noticed a bunch of datapoints missing after 11:20 UTC. attaching repro steps + screenshot: https://acme.screenshots/abc123 :confused:

Eli (Mobile Eng): thanks. which OS/browser? is this iOS-only? any console logs?

Maya (Support): iPhone 12 / iOS 16 / Safari, also repro'd on Android Chrome by the customer but less consistently. customer pasted a small log from our metrics API when they pulled CSV — got a 502 around 11:22 and then a raft of 200s returning empty arrays. snippet they sent:

```
GET /v1/metrics?series=payments_success,refunds&from=2026-12-01T10:00Z
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
{ "error": "upstream timeout" }
--- later ---
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{ "series": [[], [123, 45, 0, 2]] }
```

Maya (Support): they also mentioned billing webhook retries earlier this morning (around 11:15) which coincides with a short outage in the ingest pipeline — CS ticket has attached timeline.

Anna (Analytics): likely two separate issues that are compounding: (1) ingestion backlog/partial writes -> missing points, (2) mobile rendering picking up stale legend order mapping because labels arrive after series data. The legend swap sounds like an index-shift when dataset arrives in two waves.

Sam (Observability): I'm seeing a spike in processing latency in the metrics-ingest cluster at 11:14–11:28 UTC, correlates with billing retry storm from payment provider. trace id: trace-4f7a2. A short-lived autoscaler thrash caused some consumer groups to rebalance -> partial writes.

Eli (Mobile Eng): thanks. for the UI part we need a small reproable flow. can you ask customer to: 1) open dashboard in mobile portrait, 2) enable compact legend (three-dot menu), 3) rotate to landscape quickly, 4) tap a legend entry and watch tooltip. if legend order flips when rotation happens while series payload is still streaming, that's our bug. if they can screen-record that that's ideal.

Maya (Support): asked them for a quick screen recording + the dataset id and dashboard url. they sent one video showing exactly that behavior — uploaded to ticket. Attached: video.mp4 (6MB).

Sam (Observability): mitigation: I fast-forwarded the backlog window by increasing consumer parallelism and requeued a few failed partitions. Should see post-11:30 data fill in. Not ideal but should reduce missing points.

Eli (Mobile Eng): actionable next steps from my side: 1) patch UI to avoid binding legend order directly to streaming array indices — use stable ids/labels instead, 2) add a small debounce when a rotation event occurs while series payload is incomplete. I'll open an internal PR and mark it high priority.

Eli (Mobile Eng): temporary workaround for support: advise user to refresh once after rotation or toggle the legend list view — that forces remap.

Maya (Support): relaying workaround to AcmePay and noting that backend has been partially mitigated. customer asked if there will be SLA credit — routing to CS ops.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: mobile-legend-fix -> env:staging -> id:deploy-789

Eli (Mobile Eng): assigning myself, will target a staging build for validation. ETA for PR + staging deploy: 6 hours.

Anna (Analytics): after backend catch-up I'll run a short sweep to confirm series labels and datapoint alignment across dashboards affected by that ingestion window. I'll post any mismatches here.

Maya (Support): thanks all. CS-4128 updated with mitigation notes + link to this thread. will follow up with customer once PR is validated. :thumbsup:
